identification: Art Deco figural mantle clock attributed to Georges Maxim: reclining lady in cloche hat (probably cold-painted spelter, ivorine or ivory face and hands), doe and fawn, scalloped onyx dial surround, stepped black slate and banded onyx base, 8 day striking movement. L79 H32 cm. IMPORTANT: the photos show lot tag 809 and the description, size and title match Armitage sale 28975 lot 809 (11 Nov 2026, hammer $850), so this looks like the same clock relisted after being sold; if so the last price paid is the local cost, not resale.

Also eBay UK/US sold 'Art Deco onyx clock lady deer' and LiveAuctioneers/Invaluable sold: 'Art Deco spelter onyx mantel clock lady fawn', 'Georges Maxim clock'. Look for sold prices of this exact lady-and-doe onyx clock type (France 1930s) and whether it is ivorine face; note the Armitage 28975 lot 809 result as a prior sale.
viewing_check: Check the lot number tag and whether it is the clock sold 11 Nov 2026 as lot 809. Look for a Maxim signature on the figure base or onyx, whether the figure is spelter (magnet, weight, underside) or bronze, any chips or cracks in the onyx (dial surround, base edges), movement works and strikes, key present, ivorine crazing or damage on face and hands, and the deer for loose or missing parts.
